name: bbj
description: The docs server bbj (the hosted BBj docs server), the two BBj skills (bbj-programming, bbj-web-programming), and a compile-only check of every BBj file the agent writes (bbjcpl -N; BBj code is never run).

docs_url.title: BBj docs server URL
docs_url.description: URL of the docs server bbj; the default is the hosted BBj docs server.

bbj_home.title: BBj installation directory
bbj_home.description: BBj installation directory for the compile-only check; empty means BBJ_HOME, BBJHOME, PATH, then the usual install locations.
